name: Robbers
overview: The Scriptures warn against the company and actions of robbers, who plot violence and seek to harm the innocent without cause. Proverbs 1:11-16 vividly portrays their eagerness to ambush and destroy, motivated by greed to seize valuable possessions and fill their houses with spoil. Believers are admonished to avoid their path and refuse to share in their pursuits, recognizing that such feet run swiftly toward evil and bloodshed.
